property_summary: A deposit of exactly MinDeposit must not be accepted.
A deposit into c always succeeds (no revert) if and only if the sent value is strictly greater than MinDeposit.
The Deposit call succeeds without revert if and only if the sent amount is strictly greater than MinDeposit.

The Deposit call succeeds without revert if and only if the sent amount is strictly greater than MinDeposit.
The Deposit call succeeds without revert if and only if the sent amount is strictly greater than MinDeposit.

For any successful CashOut, a depositor can never withdraw more than their deposit-only-eligible balance, but the mutant allows deposits below MinDeposit to inflate the balance and be withdrawn, violating the invariant that total withdrawals never exceed total eligible deposits.

For any address that has only deposited through the public Deposit function, the balance returned by balances(address) must be at least MinDeposit for each deposit call that increased the balance, but the mutant allows deposits below MinDeposit to increase the balance, making this invariant false.

For any address, the sum of all successful CashOut amounts never exceeds the sum of the msg.value of deposit calls that were accepted (i.e. had msg.value > MinDeposit); the mutant incorrectly counts deposits with msg.value <= MinDeposit, allowing extra withdrawals and breaking this invariant.

For any address, after arbitrary sequences of Deposit and CashOut calls, the balance held by the contract (address(c).balance) is at least the sum of all individual balances, but the mutant allows deposits ≤ MinDeposit to inflate the sum of balances without adding to the contract's balance, breaking this invariant.

After any sequence of Deposit and CashOut operations, each depositor's balance must be exactly the sum of accepted Deposit amounts (msg.value > MinDeposit) minus successful CashOut amounts; the mutant allows deposits <= MinDeposit to increase the balance, causing a mismatch between actual balance and eligible deposits.

For any deposit above MinDeposit, the updated balance of the sender must equal the original balance plus the deposited amount; the buggy version breaks this when the addition overflows, wrapping to a smaller value.
